implementedCore.objective: Squared log EUR weekly residuals plus positive block-specific L2 penalties; unpenalized intercept; league-season and nested club-season deviations; position and training-standardized linear age.
implementedCore.solver: Deterministic coordinate descent; training-only scales/support/hash; reject non-convergence; penalties are explicit experimental options, not fitted economic multipliers.
implementedCore.safety: SYNTHETIC-only labels in all disjoint player splits; caller remains responsible for truthful provenance. No real-data loader. BASELINE abstains for unseen/sparse clubs; opt-in LEAGUE_FALLBACK_V01 permits synthetic exploration in supported leagues only. Unseen/sparse leagues and unsupported age/position abstain in both policies. No calibrated intervals, production approval or mean-bias correction.
implementedCore.limitations: Linear age only; no capacity/experience/performance effects yet; synthetic validation does not establish predictive accuracy or generalization. Future group/temporal evaluation requires eligible references; this core checks player leakage, not historical connected identities.
implementedCore.normalization: Reuse normalizeBase with explicit currency/period and dated FX; original labels retained in training hash. contextual-input.ts remains USD/year and is not silently generalized.

supersedesForFuturePrimaryModel: OVR-based A/B methodology only; v0.1 artifacts/code/hashes remain historical and unchanged
reuse: season-alignment.ts concepts for league calendars, without requiring OVR
identityVsContext: Player IDs identify/deduplicate/group records only. Club/league IDs join economic context and hierarchical groups; no player-specific memorization.

proposedModel.family: Regularized hierarchical regression of log positive gross base EUR/week
fixedEffects: documented age at salary reference (candidate spline selected using development folds)
experience before reference (senior minutes/seasons with evidence)
optionalFeatures: recent minutes and starts over a frozen pre-reference window
documented promotion/relegation or financial restrictions effective at reference
rules: No fixed arbitrary club multipliers; learn all effects only from eligible training data.
Club/league effects are hypotheses, not demonstrated gains.
Single-league MLS data cannot identify between-league differences or validate unseen leagues.
Unseen club requires measured capacity and validated pooled fallback; otherwise abstain.
Do not use contemporaneous team wage total containing target salary as a capacity feature; prior audited revenue/budget preferred.
Do not use guaranteed compensation as base or derive bonuses from its difference.

temporal.require: player, contractual salary club, playing club, league and salary reference/season evidenced; loans/transfers separate
temporal.age: derive from verified DOB at salary reference, not at collection
temporal.features: All financial/experience/performance inputs need effective period, provenance and availability by prediction cutoff; unknown remains null.
temporal.dates: Collection dates do not establish effective dates.

dataInventory.existing: MLSPA original annual USD base and separate guaranteed compensation; 93 HIGH identities (80 expansion +13 Atlanta), five expansion clubs plus Atlanta, reference 2026-04-16.
measurableNow: verified DOB-derived age on reference date
original annual base USD and guaranteed compensation separately
identity IDs and candidate club/league labels
partial: historical real-world position (EA position is not automatically equivalent)
missing: dated senior experience and performance windows

validation.splits: Group by clubs and connected player identities, temporal forward holdout when available, reserve entire leagues; no transfer/player leakage.
validation.compare: Contextual age/position baseline versus incremental hierarchy/capacity/experience/performance on identical eligible samples.
metrics: abstention and usable coverage by club/league/position/age
validation.acceptance: Predeclare thresholds and minimum support before holdout; no product approval from synthetic coherence.
abstain: interval too wide under preapproved policy

minimalNextImplementation.scope: Pure offline versioned context builder using existing hash and eligibility; remove OVR requirement, derive age, retain economic feature availability/nulls and evidence periods; no trainer or fabricated coefficients.
tests: OVR/name changes cannot change feature vector

ui: One weekly wage field remains; internal observed/provider-estimated/FutScout-estimated provenance retained. No runtime integration.
